s.h: About the job Remote BIM Modeler / 3D Visualization Specialist
s.t:
Remote position
Position: Remote BIM Modeler / 3D Visualization Specialist...

我们正在招聘一名 3D 产品可视化设计师，为 AI 消费硬件制作高质量静帧、产品页面图、广告素材和发布视觉。你会从 CAD/STP、CMF 方向和不完整的设计输入出发，快速产出可信、精致、可复用的渲染资产。
工作职责

· 清理 CAD/STP 模型并建立适合渲染的场景、材质、灯光和摄像机。

· 制作白底产品图、生活方式场景、细节特写、分解图和电商 PDP 资产。

· 准确表达塑料、金属、玻璃、织物、半透明和表面处理。

· 根据工厂样品和反馈快速调整 CMF、比例和细节。

· 交付有组织的源文件、纹理和可复用场景。
任职要求

· 提供消费电子或产品可视化作品集。
熟练使用 Blender、Cinema 4D、3ds Max、KeyShot、Octane、Redshift 或同类工具。

· 能处理 CAD/STP 输入，理解 PBR 材质、色彩管理和合成。

· 品味好、速度快，能在输入不完整时独立推进。
English
We are hiring a 3D Product Visualization Artist to create polished stills, PDP imagery, campaign assets, and launch visuals for AI consumer hardware.

Prepare CAD/STP models and build production-ready scenes, materials, lighting, and cameras.
Create clean packshots, lifestyle scenes, detail views, exploded views, and e-commerce assets.
Render plastic, metal, glass, fabric, transparency, and surface finishes accurately.
Iterate quickly from factory samples and CMF feedback; deliver organized reusable source files.

A strong consumer-electronics or product-visualization portfolio.
Fluency in Blender, Cinema 4D, 3ds Max, KeyShot, Octane, Redshift, or comparable tools.
Experience with CAD/STP inputs, PBR materials, color management, and compositing.
Excellent taste, speed, independence, and comfort working from imperfect inputs.
